title: Stocks
summary: Live watchlist with sparklines and candlestick charts for US, HK, TW and more.
description:
A watchlist of live prices with an intraday sparkline and the day's change for each stock. Press ENTER for a K-line (candlestick) chart with volume; switch the candle period between 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1D, 1W and 1M with Z/C.

Add stocks from the US, Hong Kong, Taiwan, China and Japan markets, plus indices, ETFs and crypto, by name or code. Rising color can be green (US) or red (Taiwan/China). Data comes from Yahoo Finance (no API key); refreshes every 15 seconds while a market is open.

Keys: F/X move, ENTER chart, A add, DEL remove, Shift+F/X reorder, S settings, R refresh, hold ESC 3 seconds to exit.
